sections.heading: What is chicken bone broth powder
paragraphs: Chicken bone broth powder is made from slow-simmered chicken bones. The broth is dried by low-temperature spray drying into a shelf-stable powder that keeps the flavor of bone broth.

It is a protein-rich ingredient, listed at 85 to 90% protein, with naturally occurring collagen, glucosamine and chondroitin, and amino acids including glycine and proline. The powder is soluble, so it works in drink mixes as well as dry blends.
